svg.title: City of Mages — a constellation atlas
svg.desc: Sixty-four illustrative lattice positions surrounding interlocking Swordsman and Mage tetrahedra. Workshop constellations link to the central city. Positions and connecting paths are proposed visual composition, not canonical coordinates or verified trust edges.
svg.text: THE GAP IS HELD · THE PATH REMAINS OPEN
WALKING BETWEEN SHOPS · Luca / geometry · Aletheia / persona circuit · Caducea / fitting
64 illustrative positions · coral / boundary · cyan / projection · dashed paths / proposed connections
